candidate_identity: exact action JSON; duplicates or missing actions across common futures reject evaluation
root_identity: source replay engine hash, student history and context must agree across futures and horizons
truth: mean of three frozen-v5-teacher terminal outcomes for the same action
prediction: mean of three full-precision leaf predictions from the same immutable leaves for each model; terminal leaves bypass both nets
primary_pairs: both actions have nonterminal leaves in all three futures; terminal exclusions retained and counted
supplementary_pairs: all candidates including terminal bypass; never substituted for primary pairs

bootstrap.zero_denominator: undefined, reported; any undefined resamples leave interval insufficient rather than fabricating zero

primary_gate: point improvement > 0 and 95% interval lower >= 0; incomplete or no eligible pairs cannot pass
